# Texas Franchise Tax Right-to-Transact & Officer Lookup

The Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts maintains the official record of every business entity's standing to legally transact business in Texas. This actor searches that registry by entity name, taxpayer number, or Secretary of State file number and returns right-to-transact status, registered agent, addresses and officers/directors on file.

## What this actor does

- Searches entities by name, with partial/starts-with matching
- Looks up specific entities directly by their 11-digit Comptroller taxpayer number
- Looks up specific entities directly by their Texas Secretary of State file number
- Enriches name-search hits with the full account-status record (registered agent, addresses, officers) unless disabled
- Empty fields are omitted from records — a field only appears when the registry actually has a value for it

## Output per business

- `entityName`, `dbaName` — legal name and assumed/DBA name
- `taxpayerId` — 11-digit Comptroller taxpayer number
- `feiNumber` — federal EIN, when on file
- `mailingAddress`, `mailingAddressStreet`, `mailingAddressCity`, `mailingAddressState`, `mailingAddressZip`
- `rightToTransactTX` — franchise tax right-to-transact status, e.g. `ACTIVE`, `FRANCHISE TAX ENDED`, `FRANCHISE TAX INVOLUNTARILY ENDED`, `NOT ESTABLISHED`
- `rightToTransactActionUrl`, `rightToTransactActionText` — when the entity has lapsed, the Comptroller's own "next step" link and label (e.g. request tax clearance to reinstate)
- `stateOfFormation` — state the entity was formed in
- `sosRegistrationStatus`, `effectiveSosRegistrationDate` — Secretary of State registration status and effective date
- `sosFileNumber` — Texas Secretary of State filing number
- `registeredAgentName` — the entity's registered agent
- `registeredOfficeAddress`, `registeredOfficeAddressStreet`, `registeredOfficeAddressCity`, `registeredOfficeAddressState`, `registeredOfficeAddressZip`
- `officers` — list of `{name, title, activeYear, address, source}`; `source` is `CPA` when reported on the entity's Public Information Report, or `SOS` when sourced from the Secretary of State filing
- `officerCount` — total number of officers/directors on file
- `reportYear`, `lastUpdated` — most recent franchise tax report year and last update
- `sourceUrl` — link to the official Comptroller account-status page
- `recordType` — always `business`
- `scrapedAt` — timestamp of extraction

`byTaxpayerNumber`, `bySosFileNumber`, and `byName` with `fetchDetails` on (the default) all return the full record above. With `fetchDetails` off, `byName` returns only `entityName`, `taxpayerId` and `mailingAddressZip` per match.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `byName` | `byName`, `byTaxpayerNumber` or `bySosFileNumber` |
| `entityName` | string | `walmart` | Business name, 2–50 characters (mode=byName) |
| `taxpayerNumbers` | array | `[]` | 11-digit Comptroller taxpayer numbers (mode=byTaxpayerNumber) |
| `sosFileNumbers` | array | `[]` | Texas SOS file numbers (mode=bySosFileNumber) |
| `fetchDetails` | boolean | `true` | Enrich name-search hits with the full account-status record |
| `maxOfficers` | integer | `25` | Cap on officers/directors per record (1–200) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–500) |

### Example: search by name

```json
{
  "mode": "byName",
  "entityName": "apple inc",
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

### Example: lookup by taxpayer number

```json
{
  "mode": "byTaxpayerNumber",
  "taxpayerNumbers": ["19424041101"]
}
```

### Example: lookup by Texas SOS file number

```json
{
  "mode": "bySosFileNumber",
  "sosFileNumbers": ["0004789806"]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Business verification** — confirm an entity is in good standing before signing a contract
- **Registered-agent research** — identify a company's registered agent for service of process
- **Compliance and KYC checks** — confirm franchise tax right-to-transact status before onboarding
- **Corporate intelligence** — pull the officers and directors Texas has on file for an entity
- **Due diligence** — verify a company's SOS filing number and state of formation

## FAQ

**Is this the same as the Texas Secretary of State's SOSDirect system?** No. SOSDirect is a paid subscription service; this actor reads the Comptroller's free, public Franchise Tax Account Status registry, which cross-references the same SOS registration status, file number and registered-agent data.

**What does "right to transact business in Texas" mean?** It reflects franchise tax standing. `ACTIVE` means the entity may legally operate in Texas; values like `FRANCHISE TAX ENDED` mean it has lost that right, usually for failing to file or pay franchise tax. Lapsed entities also get `rightToTransactActionUrl`/`rightToTransactActionText`, the Comptroller's own reinstatement link.

**Why do some records have no officers?** Officer and director data is self-reported on the entity's most recent Public Information Report or Ownership Information Report. New entities, sole proprietors, or entities that haven't filed a report yet may have none on file.

**Can I search by federal EIN instead of the taxpayer number?** Name search may match a federal EIN if it appears in the registry's indexed name field, but direct detail lookups require the 11-digit Comptroller taxpayer number rather than the 9-digit FEIN.

**How fresh is the data?** The Comptroller describes SOS registration status as updated each business day; other fields reflect the entity's most recently filed franchise tax report.

**What happens if I search a very common or single-word name?** The registry itself caps very broad name searches and asks for a more specific query; when that happens the run reports it via the status message rather than failing silently.

**Is this affiliated with the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts?** No. This is an independent tool built on the Comptroller's publicly published registry and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the State of Texas.
